meta.title: DSH Toolbox
meta.description: Personal tool pack: single-store memory index injection (the store root holds machine-shared entries, machines/<machine>/ holds machine-private ones) plus the workflow discipline injection (discipline.md is read on every request and the template path is rendered into templates.md; kickoff → plan challenge → build → falsification gate → commit → retro), see_image (vision model transcription via host LLM channel), dispatch_batch (batch ledger with six actions start/gate/commit/review/status/list; it records facts only — no gate, no reminder — folds state from the events, and its active-batches workbench rows are purged on the closing review), and usage_note (usage-log note hatch: the recorder listens on host tool-call events and appends this pack's three tools as a per-day, per-machine jsonl under the memory repo's memory/data/usage-log/ — successful calls keep only the argument key set and duration, failed calls keep the argument summary and error.info, and day files rotate on a 14-day window at write and registration time, synced in the same repo as the batch ledger; hidden snags that structured fields cannot hold get a note/tool/ok line, sharing one timeline with the call lines at retro time).
